senses.definition: To crush something, especially food, with a noisy crackling sound.
examples: When I came home, Susan was watching TV with her feet up on the couch, crunching a piece of celery.

quotes.text: And their white tusks crunch'd o'er the whiter skull,
quotes.reference: 1816, Lord Byron, The Siege of Corinth:

senses.definition: To be crushed with a noisy crackling sound.
examples: Beetles crunched beneath the men's heavy boots as they worked.

senses.definition: (slang) To calculate or otherwise process (e.g. to crunch numbers: to perform mathematical calculations). Presumably from the sound made by mechanical calculators.
examples: That metadata makes it much easier for the search engine to crunch the data for queries.

senses.definition: To grind or press with violence and noise.

quotes.text: The sound of our vessel crunching her way through the new ice is not easy to be described.
quotes.reference: 1854, E.K. Kane, “The United States Grinnell Expedition in Search of Sir John Franklin: a personal Narrative”, in The Living Age, page 517:

quotes.text: The departure was not unduly prolonged.[…]Within the door Mrs. Spoker hastily imparted to Mrs. Love a few final sentiments on the subject of Divine Intention in the disposition of buckets; farewells and last commiserations; a deep, guttural instigation to the horse; and the wheels of the waggonette crunched heavily away into obscurity.
quotes.reference: 1921, Ben Travers, chapter 5, in A Cuckoo in the Nest, Garden City, N.Y.: Doubleday, Page & Company, published 1925, →OCLC:

senses.definition: To emit a grinding or crunching noise.

quotes.text: There were sounds in the air above his head – sounds of the crunching and rattling of the loose, smooth stones as his neighbors moved about[…]

senses.definition: (automotive, transitive) To cause the gears to emit a crunching sound by releasing the clutch before the gears are properly synchronised.
(computing, transitive) To compress (data) using a particular algorithm, so that it can be restored by decrunching.

quotes.text: PackIt will not crunch executables, unless told to do so.
